summary: First release of sftd under the Wire release standard: SemVer versions, the image and the Helm chart at the same version, published by the release pipeline of this repository instead of Jenkins.

changes.description: Versioning: releases are now picked as SemVer versions instead of 5.0.<build number>. The image quay.io/wire/sftd and the Helm chart share that version, so the chart goes from 0.152.0 to 5.1.0. The chart is still published to the charts-avs Helm repository and also to oci://quay.io/wire/charts/stable/sftd. Pin sftd 5.1.0.
